correctness.rationale: For every leader-count orbit, the exact grounded inverse trace is derived with \(2\times2\) petal inverses and a positive hub Schur complement. Fixed-hub exchange decreases cost by \(1/3\), hub-free cost is strictly decreasing in the number of singly selected petals, and the final two rational gaps have proved signs over all \(m\ge2\), \(1\le k\le2m\). Independent exact-rational grounded inversion was replayed for 2,712 subsets, plus 11,900 count profiles; finite tests support the exact symbolic infinite-family proof.

value.rationale: The object is an established noisy consensus leader-selection invariant; an exact all-budget optimal placement rule on intersecting triangles resolves the motivated hub-centrality versus coverage tradeoff. The sharp \(3k\) versus \(2m+1\) boundary, exhaustive optimizer counts, and infinitely repeating strict nonnesting transitions provide structural design information not supplied by the generic inverse-trace formulation.
